## [1.1.0](https://github.com/sashade8-ship-it/morphe-patches-yavot/compare/v1.0.4...v1.1.0) (2026-08-09)

### Features

* YaVoT timing v3, host-managed countdown placement, and mutual exclusion with the official voice-over translation session.
* Compatibility is pinned to official Morphe Patches v1.40.0-dev.1 commit 0b2ac378feb6b64fb7f1125abdccb0ff7d9125ff.

### Distribution

* The MPP carries GPLv3 LICENSE and NOTICE resources and uses YaVoT's independent project metadata.
